edits.text: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production — INTERNAL DRAFT; NOT FOR SERVICE

PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. This document is an internal framework for responses to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production, not a complete response for service. Before service, insert each request and its corresponding response, identifying any specific objection and its basis, stating whether responsive material is being withheld on that ground, and specifying definite production dates consistent with applicable rules and court orders.

Service hold: Obtain and review each request; confirm the governing jurisdiction, service date, applicable response deadline, court orders, collection and review status, and feasible production dates. Replace prospective descriptions with complete request-specific responses. Do not assert objections or representations about withholding without a verified basis. If additional time is needed, promptly seek an express extension or appropriate court relief; conferral alone does not extend deadlines.

Confirm privilege-log content and timing under the governing rules, orders, and any agreements. Verify any actual withholding and provide the required log or other authorized disclosure on time. Remove the internal-draft designation and resolve all review comments before service.
